'''Moracen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Moracen was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Silvarte]]. In the wake of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Moracen studied on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. During her training, Moracen fell in love with fellow apprentice, [[Spanios]], as both were regularly assigned to work with each other. Developing a strong bond with each other, they discovered a rare [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] amidst the ruins of the ancient fortress city of [[Kaleth]]. Despite their attempts at discretion, the pairs' masters became suspicious of their activities and sent another Padawan to discover whether the two apprentices were indeed romantically involved.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
When dealing with Moracen and Spanios, Jedi Knight and Consular players have three options. They can reveal the romantic relationship to Moracen and Spanios' relationship to their Masters for light side points, lie and keep it hidden for dark side points, or lie for dark side points, and later convince Spanios to break off the relationship with Moracen for light side points.

She is voiced by [[Catherine Taber]] who also voices [[Vette]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
